study_design: Case-control study of histologically diagnosed prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia, and controls
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Blood and urine samples from men with histologically diagnosed PCa (n = 90), BPH (n = 97), and controls (n = 98) were analyzed for trace elements, including selenium.
reason: The abstract evaluates prostate cancer overall in a case-control study and does not report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Men in the lowest and highest blood selenium tertiles had increased odds of PCa {AOR (95% CI): 2.90 (1.13, 7.46) and 4.42 (1.68, 11.59), respectively}.
estimate_classifications.reason: The row concerns overall prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype. The abstract directly reports associations between blood selenium and PCa.
